$comment: Safe mutation contract for the Customer Product Editor (PRD §editor). The in-space editor (apps/ProductStudio) and the trackb-project server function BOTH enforce this contract; the server function is authoritative. Anything not listed here is rejected explicitly — never silently applied. The customer never receives CodeMirror or raw composition source; the editor wraps @hyperframes/player, it is not a second composition engine.

set_duration.validation: within the scene's PLANNER timing_range AND global scene_duration_bounds_s

set_music_track.validation: must be the id of a FROZEN audio asset in the project ledger

set_brand_primary.validation: must name an existing brand token — colour edits are brand-token based, never free hex

set_brand_accent.validation: must name an existing brand token

regenerate_scene.validation: scene must be EDITABLE; enforced budget: max_attempts_per_scene, max_credits_per_scene, max_credits_per_project, escalation_threshold; isolated — never touches other scenes; creates a recoverable version snapshot first

rules.editable_states_only: Mutations apply only to scenes in state EDITABLE. BAKED (Track A footage), REGENERATING, ERROR and LOCKED scenes reject mutations with an explanation the UI must surface.
rules.quote_before_expensive: Any operation whose credit cost ≥ credits.json expensive_threshold must be quoted to the customer BEFORE execution.
rules.no_charge_on_failure: A mutation that fails validation or persistence produces no billable work and deducts no credits; the previous valid state is preserved.
rules.undo_redo: Every successful customer-visible mutation pushes an inverse entry onto the undo stack; redo replays it; undo/redo are free.
rules.live_sync: A successful edit propagates atomically to: saved project, composition source (next build), preview, timeline, scene thumbnails, player state, undo history. A partial update is a failure and is rolled back.
rules.user_wins: If an agent mutation targets a field the user changed after the version the agent read, the user's value is preserved, the agent's intent is logged in the activity log, and no overwrite occurs — no dialog, pure automation.
rules.agent_visibility: Agent edits are ordinary logged mutations: visible in the activity log (e.g. 'Updating headline in Scene 03') and undoable exactly like user edits.
rules.version_identity: Every mutation bumps project.version; every render records the exact project/schema/manifest/composition/audio/voice versions it consumed.
